seo.title: Burlington Bathrooms Fitted in Stoke Poges | Fit-Only Installation
seo.description: We install Burlington's classic bathroom range across Stoke Poges' period and executive-style houses, fit-only, from £3,500.

h1: Burlington bathroom installation in Stoke Poges

hero.intro: Stoke Poges mixes older period detached houses with more recent executive-style builds, many set well back from the road on sizeable gardens around Stoke Park — and it's the kind of housing stock where a Burlington bathroom often suits the property better than a purely contemporary range would. Burlington's pedestal and wall-hung basins, close-coupled and high-level WCs, roll-top baths and period-style brassware give a room a traditional character, whether that's matching an existing period house or adding a sense of history to a newer build. We fit Burlington ranges across Stoke Poges on a fit-only basis, from £3,500, after a £125 survey.

sections.heading: Why Burlington suits Stoke Poges' mix of housing
sections.body: Older detached houses in Stoke Poges often already have the proportions a Burlington range was designed for — generous bathroom footprints, period-style joinery, high ceilings that suit a high-level WC's exposed flush pipe. In the newer executive-style builds nearby, the same range gets specified to introduce a traditional character the house wasn't originally designed with, and the fixing underneath has to work just as hard either way: a modern standard supporting pedestal and wall-hung basins, close-coupled and high-level WCs, and roll-top baths, regardless of when the house itself was built.

sections.heading: The room Stoke Poges' plots give us to work with
sections.body: The scale of plot common here — large gardens, houses set back from the road, few shared party walls — generally gives us far more flexibility on layout than a smaller or terraced property would. Relocating a waste run, widening a doorway for level access, or adding a second en-suite off a principal bedroom rarely runs into the structural constraints we'd meet elsewhere, which matters for a Burlington installation, since a roll-top bath needs clearance to read as freestanding and a pedestal basin needs the right proportions around it to look period-correct rather than squeezed in.

sections.heading: Fixing detail on a Burlington installation
sections.body: The classic silhouette Burlington is known for — close-coupled and high-level WCs, pedestal and wall-hung basins, roll-top baths — sits on a modern fixing standard that isn't visible once the room is finished: the bracket behind a wall-hung basin, the bearing under a roll-top bath's feet, the support behind a high-level cistern. We confirm that detail at survey stage for every Burlington piece specified, so the fixing is settled before a wall or floor closes up, not discovered on fitting day.

sections.heading: Aftercare for a Burlington installation
sections.body: Once a Burlington bathroom is fitted, the kind of faults that can show up later — a wall-hung basin's hidden bracket working loose, a roll-top bath's feet shifting slightly, a high-level cistern developing a drip — are repairable rather than something you'd need to replace the whole piece for. We carry out repairs to Burlington fittings across Stoke Poges from £200, with a £500 minimum for an emergency call-out. We don't take on standalone regrouting-only visits.

faqs.q: Does Burlington suit a period Stoke Poges house, or only a newer build?
faqs.a: Both. Its pedestal and wall-hung basins, close-coupled and high-level WCs and roll-top baths work in an older period property and are equally often specified in a newer executive-style build to add traditional character.

faqs.q: Can you add a second en-suite with a Burlington range in a Stoke Poges property?
faqs.a: Often, yes. The larger plots and houses set back from the road around Stoke Poges generally give us more flexibility on layout and waste runs than a smaller property allows.

faqs.q: What fixing detail matters most with a Burlington wall-hung basin?
faqs.a: The hidden support bracket behind it. It's never visible once the basin is fitted, but it's what stops the basin working loose from the wall months after installation.

faqs.q: What does a Burlington fit-only installation in Stoke Poges cost?
faqs.a: From £3,500, following a £125 survey where we confirm the fixing route for whichever Burlington pieces you've specified.

faqs.q: Do you offer an emergency call-out for a Burlington fitting that's failed?
faqs.a: Yes, from a £500 minimum call-out charge. Routine repairs to Burlington fittings start from £200, though we don't take on standalone regrouting-only visits.

image.heroPrompt: Purpose: hero image for the Burlington x Stoke Poges installer page, implying the brand's wall-hung basin and support detail through a close side-profile fixture shot. Subject and action: a side-profile close shot of a wall-hung basin viewed from a low angle showing the underside curve and the wall plane it's mounted to, a single period-style basin tap visible on the rim, static, no water. Setting and work-stage: a finished en-suite in a Stoke Poges period-style detached house, early evening, warm light from a single wall-mounted sconce just out of frame. Composition: low side-angle crop emphasising the basin's underside curve and the wall junction beneath it, a warm walnut timber shelf edge visible in soft focus to one side. Light and materials: white vitreous china basin, brushed bronze tap, warm walnut timber accent shelf, warm low-angle light from one practical wall sconce creating a defined soft shadow under the basin's curve. Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no brand names visible on fixtures, no LED strip lighting anywhere in frame, no twin symmetrical basins, no single uniform amber wash across the whole frame — light should fall unevenly from the single sconce only, no plants, florals or candles as props, no water shown running, believable varied sheen on the china and timber.
image.heroAlt: Low side-profile shot of a wall-hung basin's underside and brushed bronze tap against a warm walnut shelf, evening sconce light, Stoke Poges.
